visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and glasses, wearing a bright yellow long-sleeved sweater over a white collared shirt and black shorts, stands in front of a white wall decorated with black-and-white manga-style illustrations. He faces the camera, gesturing with his hands and giving two thumbs up while speaking. The lighting is bright and even, typical of an indoor exhibition space. (2) The camera zooms in to a close-up of the man's face. He continues to speak enthusiastically, his facial expressions animated. The background remains the same manga-style wall, providing a clean yet artistic context. (3) The scene cuts to a full shot where the man stands in a wider, minimalist exhibition hall with a high ceiling and a visible green industrial fan. He remains still while a small 'bamboo-copter' prop on his head begins to spin mechanically. He maintains a neutral, almost deadpan facial expression as the object rotates. (4) In the same setting, the man holds his pose for several seconds as the bamboo-copter continues to spin. He eventually breaks his neutral expression into a wide smile, looking directly at the viewer. (5) The man smiles, says something brief, and then walks towards the camera. He reaches his hand out toward the lens to terminate the recording, his body becoming a partial close-up before the screen goes dark.
